class.name: PlayerServer
class.description: The one owner of the vehicle the player drives (the original's [code]simulation::Train[/code]). Taking a vehicle over, entering its cab while its driver drives on and letting it go happen here, by the vehicles' [RailVehicleServer] handles, whoever asks - the keys, the HUD, scripts ([code]maszyna.player[/code]) - and are announced by [signal player_vehicle_changed]; the player's node follows it into the cab and out. The player's person going through a gangway into the next vehicle ([method RailVehicleServer.person_change_cabin]) takes the player there as well - driving, with its vehicle's driver, while the driver of the vehicle entered gets out. It knows nothing of the view: [PlayerCameraServer] follows [signal player_vehicle_entered] into the cab.

method.name: player_enter_vehicle
method.description: The player sits in the vehicle's cab and its driver, if it has one, drives on; the trainset left - when another one - is driven by its drivers again. Refused for a vehicle without a node, whose cab there is nothing to sit in. Emits [signal player_vehicle_entered].

method.name: player_get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle the player drives, an invalid [RID] for none.

method.name: player_leave_vehicle
method.description: The player lets the trainset go: its drivers drive it again (simulation.cpp:257-270).

method.name: player_take_over_vehicle
method.description: The player takes the vehicle over: the vehicle's driver stops driving it (drivermode.cpp:266), the trainset left - when another one - is driven by its drivers again, and the vehicle's cab is activated when its FIZ allows it (Train.cpp:9147). Refused for a vehicle without a node, whose cab there is nothing to sit in. The vehicle already driven is only taken back from its driver. Emits [signal player_vehicle_entered] either way.

signal.name: player_vehicle_changed
signal.description: What the player drives changed: [param vehicle] now, [param previous] before; an invalid [RID] for none. Also emitted when the vehicle driven is freed.

signal.name: player_vehicle_entered
signal.description: The player entered [param vehicle] - taken over or not - also the vehicle it already drives, which is only taken back from its driver when taken over (the original's F5 on its own train, [code]drivermode.cpp:258-267[/code]).
